title.zh: 授予Domiciano B. De Jesus与Emilio Olores在邦阿西楠省Bani市镇当地经营电灯、热力与动力系统的特许经营权的法案
title.en: An Act Granting Domiciano B. De Jesus and Emilio Olores a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Bani, Province of Pangasinan
title.orig: An Act Granting Domiciano B. De Jesus and Emilio Olores a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Bani, Province of Pangasinan
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp quyền khai thác cho Domiciano B. De Jesus and Emilio Olores để xây dựng, lắp đặt, vận hành và duy trì hệ thống điện tại thị xã Bani, tỉnh Pangasinan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ Domiciano B. De Jesus and Emilio Olores เพื่อก่อสร้าง ติดตั้ง ดำเนินการ และบำรุงรักษาระบบไฟฟ้าในเทศบาล Bani, จังหวัด Pangasinan
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan waralaba kepada Domiciano B. De Jesus and Emilio Olores untuk membangun, memasang, mengoperasikan, dan memelihara sistem tenaga listrik di Kotamadya Bani, Provinsi Pangasinan
title.ms: Akta memberikan francais kepada Domiciano B. De Jesus and Emilio Olores untuk membina, memasang, mengendalikan dan menyelenggara sistem tenaga elektrik di Perbandaran Bani, Wilayah Pangasinan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_258_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-two, and to the provisions of the Constitution, there is granted to Domiciano B. de Jesus and Emilio Olores, for a period of twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege, and authority to construct, maintain, and operate an electric light, heat and power plant for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and/or power for sale within the municipality of Bani, Province of Pangasinan.

It is expressly provided that in the event the government should desire to maintain and operate for itself the plant and enterprise herein authorized, the grantees shall surrender their franchise and will turn over to the government all serviceable equipment therein, at cost.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 14, 1948.
